subject: RECORD clause
notes: kb/Work PB345 (landed). RULE: 'If no record description entries are specified in a file description entry for a file that is not a report file, the RECORD clause shall be specified.' - cite.py --check 13.18.43.3 'If no record description entries are specified in a file description entry for a file that is not a report file, the RECORD clause shall be specified.' -> OK 13.18.43.3 1). Enforced as COBOL1836, which reads the rule as 14.9.30.4 GR6 makes it load-bearing: the clause has to establish a MAXIMUM, because GR6 sizes the implied record description by 'the maximum size established by the RECORD clause'. Two negatives, both rejecting at all four editions: the absent clause, and the written format-2 clause with no TO phrase (13.18.43.4 GR10 refers that case to the largest record DESCRIBED, and this file describes none). The exclusion 'for a file that is not a report file' is exercised the other way by the existing report-file corpus, whose FDs legally carry neither a record description entry nor a RECORD clause.
